instruction: Change the maximum volume limit in VLC preferences to 200%.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing maximum volume setting in VLC preferences (Tools > Preferences > Audio > Maximum volume level). The evaluator checks VLC config file for qt-max-volume=200. Uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric from vlc.py.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to change VLC maximum volume limit to 200%
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly retrieves VLC config file from OS-specific location (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc on Linux)
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses config file and checks for qt-max-volume=200 setting
Expected value '200' correctly matches the 200% requirement in the instruction
Metric properly handles default value (125) if setting not found in config file
Metric correctly handles type conversion (int to string) for comparison
Metric correctly accesses rule parameter directly (rule['expected_qt_max_volume']) without incorrect nested access patterns
No postconfig needed - VLC config file is persistent and accessible after preferences are saved
